# Difmeil

> Difmeil is a Chrome extension that brings multiple Gmail accounts into one inbox.

It is intended for people managing several Gmail accounts, such as personal and
work accounts. The extension provides a quick popup and a full-page inbox inside
the browser. It is not a separate webmail service.

Features include reading, composing, replying, forwarding with attachments,
searching across accounts, notifications and bulk mail actions. Some notification
and personalization options require Pro; the product pages describe plan limits.
This summary does not replace those pages or the privacy policies.

Install from the official Chrome Web Store listing, open the extension from the
browser toolbar and authorize each Gmail account through Google OAuth. Requests
to read and manage mail go directly between the browser and Google. An
authorization service exchanges and refreshes tokens without storing them.

This file is an experimental, complementary product summary. It is not an official
search-engine requirement, an indexing guarantee or a guarantee of AI citations.
It does not change the site's robots.txt policy.
